sources.label_basis: Published question-to-human-answer association, binary link grade 1
sources.scope: Complete finance.jsonl questions with published nonempty human answers; human answer corpus only. Original ChatGPT answers remain in raw file and do not create labels.
limitations: Development adaptation of published unsplit QA, not an official held-out retrieval benchmark.
Answers may be short or conversational; source association is not an exhaustive relevance or factual-correctness judgment.
Missing human answer slots and questions without a valid human answer are explicitly audited.
ChatGPT answers are outside the human-only corpus scope, never treated as positive or negative labels.

sources.label_basis: Published test-row positive list, binary link grade 1
sources.scope: Complete published MTEB reranking test split; corpus is exact-text union of every positive and negative candidate. Every test query is retained.
limitations: Derived union-corpus retrieval, not the original per-query reranking evaluation.
Corpus units are question titles, not complete Stack Overflow post bodies.
Unjudged cross-query candidates remain unjudged; no negative-label propagation.
Source has no native IDs: every row and candidate position is preserved in deterministic IDs/aliases.
